title: SurrealDB write/read contention: p95_latency_ms=2020.8>2000 (p50=15.5ms, slow_queries=50, qps=5.04). Likely a write-stor
description: SurrealDB write/read contention: p95_latency_ms=2020.8>2000 (p50=15.5ms, slow_queries=50, qps=5.04). Likely a write-storm or hot-row UPDATE pattern saturating the single-writer engine. Inspect by_op in /metrics/db; mitigations: batch hot-table writes, detach posterior/penalty writes from request hot paths, reduce failure-trace volume.
